title: Homeadvisor vs Thumbtack vs Angi's: Lead Generation Programs Compared

facts.fact: HomeAdvisor is a pay-per-lead platform, and contractors must also pay an annual membership fee to be listed on the site.
facts.quote: HomeAdvisor is a pay-per-lead platform. However, you also have to pay an annual membership fee to be listed on the site.

facts.fact: HomeAdvisor charges a lead fee even when the potential client does not choose the contractor to complete the project.
facts.quote: HomeAdvisor charges you a lead fee even if the potential client doesn't end up choosing you to complete their project.

facts.fact: HomeAdvisor has two lead types: Market Match leads, which are shared with other providers in the area, and Exact Match leads, which are exclusive to the contractor's company.
facts.quote: Market Match leads are shared. They go to you and to other service providers in your area. Exact Match leads are exclusive leads to your company.

facts.fact: On HomeAdvisor, Exact Match leads cost more than Market Match leads.
facts.quote: You pay more for Exact Match leads than for Market Match.

facts.fact: HomeAdvisor's account approval includes a background check plus sex offender, civil judgment, and state license screening.
facts.quote: The HomeAdvisor system will conduct a background check as well as a sex offender, civil judgment, and state license screening.

facts.fact: When a contractor signs up for HomeAdvisor, the contractor gives HomeAdvisor the right to use the contractor's business name for its own marketing.
facts.quote: when you sign up for HomeAdvisor, you give them the right to use your business name for their own marketing.

facts.fact: Registration on Thumbtack is free for contractors.
facts.quote: Registration on Thumbtack is free for contractors.

facts.fact: On Thumbtack, contractors pay for leads when potential clients ask for a bid.
facts.quote: You pay for leads when potential clients ask for a bid.

facts.fact: Thumbtack charges automatically for exact match leads.
facts.quote: Thumbtack charges you automatically for exact match leads.

facts.fact: On Thumbtack, opportunity leads are paid for only if the potential customer responds to the contractor's offer.
facts.quote: You only pay for these leads if the potential customer responds to your offer.

facts.fact: Thumbtack's Instant Match is an automated tool that pre-submits a contractor's services and pricing and sends a bid on the contractor's behalf when a relevant job posting appears.
facts.quote: When a relevant job posting comes up, Thumbtack automatically sends a bid on your behalf.

facts.fact: On Thumbtack, lead prices rise when many contractors compete for the same jobs.
facts.quote: If many contractors are competing for the same jobs, the price of the leads goes up.
